```{=typst}
#let mk(n) = box(baseline: 22%, circle(radius: 5.8pt, fill: rgb("#d9480f"), stroke: none, inset: 0pt)[#set align(center + horizon); #text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8pt)[#n]])
#let tick = box(baseline: 12%, width: 10pt, height: 10pt, stroke: 0.9pt + luma(70), radius: 2pt)
#let shot(path, w: 100%) = block(breakable: false, stroke: 0.8pt + luma(150), radius: 6pt, clip: true, image(path, width: w))
#let typebox(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#f1f6fd"), stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 5pt, inset: (x: 12pt, y: 9pt), body)
#let tip(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#fff4e6"), stroke: (left: 3pt + rgb("#d9480f")), inset: (x: 10pt, y: 7pt), radius: 3pt, body)
// One step: the box to tick, its number and what to do on the left; its screen on the right.
#let step(n, body, img: none, w: 100%, left: 40%, after: none) = block(breakable: false, above: 9pt, below: 9pt, width: 100%)[
  #set par(justify: false, leading: 0.62em)
  #let words = grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 6pt, [#tick #h(1pt) *#n.*], body)
  #if img == none { words } else {
    grid(columns: (left, 1fr), column-gutter: 12pt, align: (top, top), words, align(center, shot(img, w: w)))
  }
  #if after != none { v(4pt); after }
]
```

::: {.lead}
Today you make a small digital service: Mona sells home-made cakes. You type its **plan** in Word, then you make its **order form** in Microsoft Forms. Do the tasks in order. The **orange
numbers** in each picture show where to click. Tick the box `#tick`{=typst} after each step. Stuck? Raise your hand.
:::

- **You need:** a lab computer with Microsoft Forms. **Nothing to download:**
  you type the text yourself.
- **Time:** about 35 minutes. Your Microsoft Forms may look a little different:
  the names of the buttons are the same.

## Task 1 · The plan of the service in Word

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Open *Word* (Search › word), then *Blank document*. Type these four lines (*Enter* after each):], after: [#v(2pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 6pt)[Mona's Cakes: the plan \ The customer: students and families in Amman. \ The need: a fresh cake on the right day. \ The steps: see the cakes, choose, order, collect.]])
#step(2, [Click in the first line #mk(1). In *Home › Styles*, click *Title* #mk(2).], img: "images/lab-plan-1.png", w: 100%, left: 36%)
#step(3, [Press *F12*. Click *Desktop*, type *plan-* and your first name, click *Save*.])
```

## Task 2 · A new form

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Open the browser. Go to *forms.office.com*. Click *Sign in* and use your *university account*.])
#step(2, [Click *New Form* #mk(1).], img: "images/lab-forms-1.png", w: 84%, left: 30%)
#step(3, [Click *Untitled form* #mk(1) and type: #h(3pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[Mona's Cakes: order]], img: "images/lab-forms-2.png", w: 100%, left: 36%)
```

## Task 3 · Three questions

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click *+ Add new* (#mk(2) in the picture above), then *Text*. Type: #h(2pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[Your name] \ Turn on *Required* #mk(1).], img: "images/lab-forms-3.png", w: 92%, left: 36%)
#step(2, [*+ Add new › Choice*. Type: #h(2pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[Which cake?] \ The options #mk(2): *Chocolate*, *Strawberry*, then *+ Add option*: *Vanilla*.])
#step(3, [*+ Add new › Date*. Type: #h(2pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[When do you want it?] #mk(3)])
```

```{=typst}
#pagebreak(weak: true)
```

## Task 4 · A test order

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click *Preview* #mk(1). Fill in a test order #mk(2): your name, a cake, a date. \ Click *Submit* #mk(3). Then *Back*.], img: "images/lab-forms-4.png", w: 92%, left: 36%)
```

## Task 5 · The responses

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click *Responses* #mk(1): 1 response, your test order. \ Click *Open results in Excel* #mk(2): one row for each order.], img: "images/lab-result-1.png", w: 100%, left: 36%)
```
